title: YouRejoined
description: Server to one, event `you:rejoined`. Everything this player already knows, sent after they reconnect to their seat. Contains nothing they weren't sent before.

phase.description: Current phase and timer. Null while the room is still in the lobby.

you.description: This player's role and costume. Null while the room is still in the lobby.

results.description: Every private Day result this player has received, oldest first.

lastCandleTargetId.description: Who this player lit a candle for last Day, so the phone can grey them out tonight. Null if none.

powerUsed.description: Monster only. True once the Monster's power is spent, so the button stays hidden.
